summary: Cross-platform visual management tool for OpenAI Codex, featuring provider/API switching, session sync, prompt injection, Skills/MCP management, and TOML config visualization.
usecases: Switching between multiple OpenAI providers/APIs seamlessly within one interface.
Managing and syncing Codex sessions across desktop and CLI workflows.
Visualizing and editing TOML-based Codex configurations and prompt templates.
ideas: Add built-in prompt optimization and version comparison.
Integrate with MCP (Model Context Protocol) registries for shared skills.
Enable team-wide provider quotas and usage analytics dashboard.
